response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development, open-source contributions, and leadership through workshops and mentoring, but his background lacks direct experience with C++ (only minimal mention of C/C++) and large-scale distributed systems in production. His cloud architecture experience appears limited to Kubernetes deployments and AWS CDK, not full cloud compute platform leadership. While he demonstrates technical breadth, the role requires deeper specialization in C++ and cloud infrastructure.
strengths: Strong leadership and mentorship through workshops, talks, and team contributions (e.g., Selenium course, Refactoring Dojos).
Proven ability to build and scale platforms (e.g., GISCollective, re:cinq’s AI-agent infrastructure).
Diverse technical stack spanning system-level work (DLang, C++), web, and cloud technologies.
concerns: Insufficient C++ experience (only ~1 year in past roles) against the 8-year minimum requirement.
Limited direct experience with large-scale distributed systems or compute/storage hardware architecture.
Cloud architecture focus appears more operational (Kubernetes, AWS CDK) than strategic (balancing short/long-term needs).
